thought.text: Let me find the root cause of the Spring bean failure:

reasoning_content: The listener failed because the bean instantiation failed. We need the actual root cause. Let's look for the root exception (BeanCreationException / Caused by) earlier in the logs.

action.command: grep -E "Caused by|BeanCreationException|Could not|Failed to|Exception:" /opt/tomcat-anwendung/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "grep -E \"Caused by|BeanCreationException|Could not|Failed to|Exception:\" /opt/tomcat-anwendung/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m//g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Extract root cause exceptions from log"}
